column1: # /mirage/GetInfo response parsers, in the order the native code resolves them:
#   00933d80 Parse_InstBase   -> bg_res, dlg_begin, dlg_end, new_record, floor,
#   009343b4 ParseStairInfo   -> res_prefix, res_postfix_list, list, grade, balance
#   0092dff4 Parse_InstEnemy  -> n, ref_id, rank, rank_up_cnt, overcome_cnt,
#   009359ac (dispatcher)     -> ret_data x2, achievement x2, entry x2,
#                                inst_base x2, inst_enemy x2, ref_stair x2,
# The dispatcher resolves each of entry / inst_base / inst_enemy / ref_stair /
# ref_hero TWICE at consecutive slots, which is the signature of
# "if (json.contains(k)) { ... } else { ... }" i.e. each block is optional.
# An absent block is therefore survivable; a present-but-empty one is not.
# resource-name literals used by the mirage scene:
#   01d72e63  [0-9]+         (regex to split them off a res name)
